original_statement:
What must hold? State the invariant or expectation this concerns. In src/nitro/MultiAssetHolder.sol, transfer and reclaim move a finalized channel's collateral by spending the old pool commitment and minting new ones through pool.transactOwned, not by decrementing a uint256 and calling raw-asset interactions. A transfer of part of a channel's collateral pays the named destination a fresh owned commitment of the paid amount, and leaves holdings[asset][channelId] pointing at a fresh commitment of the remainder. A transfer that pays out the whole collateral in one asset sets holdings[asset][channelId] to bytes32(0). reclaim moves a guarantee's value into the target channel's commitment, read by heldValue.
What holds now? Describe the current, observed state. transfer's interaction step calls _executeSingleAssetExit, which moves raw assets and wrote uint256 holdings before N1a. reclaim writes its holdings directly. ArmadaNitroAdjudicator._executeSingleAssetExit still calls _transferAsset for an external destination.
How do you see it? Describe exactly how to observe this for yourself — the steps to reproduce, or how you would demo it. forge test --match-contract MultiAssetHolderCommitmentTest and forge test --match-contract ArmadaNitroAdjudicatorTest both finish with no failed tests. In the partial-transfer test the named destination holds a fresh commitment of the paid amount, and holdings[asset][channelId] holds a fresh commitment of the remainder. In the full-payout test holdings[asset][channelId] equals bytes32(0). In the reclaim test heldValue of the target channel rose by the guarantee value. forge build and the whole forge test suite finish with no failed tests.
restatement: In src/nitro/MultiAssetHolder.sol, transfer and reclaim must move a finalized channel's collateral by spending the old pool commitment and minting new ones through pool.transactOwned. They must not decrement a uint256 and call raw-asset interactions. A partial transfer pays the named destination a fresh owned commitment of the paid amount and leaves holdings[asset][channelId] pointing at a fresh commitment of the remainder. A transfer that pays out the whole collateral in one asset sets holdings[asset][channelId] to bytes32(0). reclaim moves a guarantee's value into the target channel's commitment, read by heldValue. ArmadaNitroAdjudicator._executeSingleAssetExit no longer calls _transferAsset for an external destination. forge build and the whole forge test suite finish with no failed tests.

restatement_clauses.text: A partial transfer of a channel's collateral pays the named destination a fresh owned commitment of the paid amount, minted through pool.transactOwned.
After a partial transfer, holdings[asset][channelId] points at a fresh commitment of the remainder.
A transfer that pays out the whole collateral in one asset sets holdings[asset][channelId] to bytes32(0).
reclaim moves a guarantee's value into the target channel's commitment: heldValue of the target channel rises by the guarantee value.

transfer and reclaim spend the old pool commitment and mint new ones through pool.transactOwned, and ArmadaNitroAdjudicator._executeSingleAssetExit no longer calls _transferAsset for an external destination; no raw-asset movement happens on these paths.

forge test --match-contract MultiAssetHolderCommitmentTest and forge test --match-contract ArmadaNitroAdjudicatorTest finish with no failed tests, and forge build and the whole forge test suite finish with no failed tests.

goal: Make finalized-channel collateral move through pool commitments in transfer and reclaim, with no plain-number holdings and no raw-asset payout.
acceptance_criteria: After a partial transfer, the named destination holds a new commitment worth exactly the paid amount.
After a partial transfer, the channel's holding points at a new commitment worth exactly the remainder.
After a transfer that pays out all of the collateral in one asset, the channel's holding for that asset is the zero value.
After a reclaim, the target channel's held value is larger by exactly the guarantee value.
Paying out to an external destination through the adjudicator moves value as pool commitments and sends no raw asset directly.
The commitment-based collateral tests and the adjudicator tests all pass together.
